kernel=Image
arm_64bit=1
enable_uart=1
# Full KMS: kernel drives all displays including the DSI panel
dtoverlay=vc4-kms-v3d
# Firmware must not pre-configure the display pipeline (matches RPi OS)
disable_fw_kms_setup=1
# Raspberry Pi 5-inch Touch Display 2 (ILI9881 panel, Goodix touch)
dtoverlay=vc4-kms-dsi-ili9881-5inch
# Codec Zero (I2S DAC/ADC, DA7212)
dtparam=audio=off
dtparam=i2c_arm=on
dtparam=i2s=on
dtoverlay=rpi-codeczero
# Control I/O companion: UART4 uses GPIO8 TX / GPIO9 RX. The MIDI clock
# overlay makes userspace B38400 produce the physical MIDI rate of 31.25 kbaud.
dtoverlay=uart4
dtoverlay=midi-uart4
# Expression pedal ADC on the existing I2C1 bus, AIN0 single-ended, 4.096 V
# full scale, 128 samples/s. ADDR is grounded on the companion schematic.
dtoverlay=ads1115,addr=0x48,cha_enable,cha_cfg=4,cha_gain=1,cha_datarate=4
# Footswitches, encoder, and default-low GPIO10 audio-output relay control
# (compiled from ardor-controls.dts)
dtoverlay=ardor-controls
